inputs.text: None. The report says the duty officer "was not acting on any information concerning any nuclear incident"; the action was the routine shift-change practice alert, meant for the Alert Ready training system.

fields.description: EXERCISE - THIS IS A PRACTICE MESSAGE ONLY. Emergency Management Ontario is testing its alert training system. There is no emergency anywhere. No action is required.

fields.instruction: This is a drill. No action is needed. Do not call 911 about this message.
left_out: The template wording about a nuclear incident and people within ten kilometres of the Pickering Nuclear Generating Station. No verified input supports it: the verified timeline says the duty officer was not acting on any information about a nuclear incident. Naming a nuclear station in a practice message could cause real alarm if it reached the public.
No area or time was given. None of the inputs describes a real hazard area, and the operator chose no target area for this training-system practice alert.
fields.note_for_reviewer: Before approving, confirm this goes only to the Alert Ready training system and not to live public distribution, because no target area is intended. Please also make sure the stock Pickering nuclear template text is fully removed.
